description: Create a new ad set. Requires name, campaign_id, budget, optimization_goal, billing_event, and targeting. Defaults to PAUSED status.

account_id.description: Ad account ID to create the ad set in (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

adset_schedule.description: Hourly delivery intervals (Sunday=0). Requires lifetime budgeting. Set timezone_type explicitly; Meta defaults to USER.

attribution_spec.description: Attribution windows; Meta validates compatibility with the objective and optimization goal

bid_amount.description: Bid amount in the account currency's minor unit. Required for COST_CAP or LOWEST_COST_WITH_BID_CAP except Reach and Frequency.

bid_strategy.description: Bid strategy: LOWEST_COST_WITHOUT_CAP, LOWEST_COST_WITH_BID_CAP, COST_CAP, LOWEST_COST_WITH_MIN_ROAS

billing_event.description: Billing event: APP_INSTALLS, CLICKS, IMPRESSIONS, LINK_CLICKS, NONE, OFFER_CLAIMS, PAGE_LIKES, POST_ENGAGEMENT, THRUPLAY, PURCHASE, LISTING_INTERACTION

destination_type.description: Conversion destination, e.g. WEBSITE, APP, MESSENGER, INSTAGRAM_DIRECT, WHATSAPP

dsa_beneficiary.description: Beneficiary of EU-targeted ads; may use the account's saved default when omitted

dsa_payor.description: Payer of EU-targeted ads; does not automatically copy dsa_beneficiary. May use the account's saved default.

optimization_goal.description: Optimization goal: NONE, APP_INSTALLS, AD_RECALL_LIFT, ENGAGED_USERS, EVENT_RESPONSES, IMPRESSIONS, LEAD_GENERATION, QUALITY_LEAD, LINK_CLICKS, OFFSITE_CONVERSIONS, PAGE_LIKES, POST_ENGAGEMENT, QUALITY_CALL, REACH, LANDING_PAGE_VIEWS, VISIT_INSTAGRAM_PROFILE, ENGAGED_PAGE_VIEWS, VALUE, THRUPLAY, DERIVED_EVENTS, APP_INSTALLS_AND_OFFSITE_CONVERSIONS, CONVERSATIONS, IN_APP_VALUE, MESSAGING_PURCHASE_CONVERSION, MESSAGING_DEEP_CONVERSATION_AND_FOLLOW, SUBSCRIBERS, REMINDERS_SET, MEANINGFUL_CALL_ATTEMPT, PROFILE_VISIT, PROFILE_AND_PAGE_ENGAGEMENT, ADVERTISER_SILOED_VALUE, AUTOMATIC_OBJECTIVE, MESSAGING_APPOINTMENT_CONVERSION

pacing_type.description: Pacing settings. When a schedule is supplied, day_parting is required and is added if omitted.

promoted_object.description: JSON string of the promoted_object spec. Required for many objectives, e.g. OUTCOME_SALES needs {"pixel_id":"...","custom_event_type":"PURCHASE"}, OUTCOME_APP_PROMOTION needs {"application_id":"...","object_store_url":"..."}, OUTCOME_ENGAGEMENT page-like ads need {"page_id":"..."}. Omitting it when the objective requires one causes ad set creation to fail.

targeting.description: JSON string of targeting spec (age_min, age_max, genders, geo_locations, interests, etc.). Advantage+ Audience automation and other flags go inside this object too, e.g. targeting_automation: {"advantage_audience":1}. As of v26.0, ad sets in the Housing, Employment, or Financial Products and Services (HEC-F) special ad categories with relaxable (non-broad) targeting must explicitly set targeting.targeting_automation.advantage_audience to 1 or 0 — omitting it now returns ADS_TARGETING__REQUIRE_EXPLICIT_ADVANTAGE_AUDIENCE_FLAG. Not required for broad/default audience setups. Also note: as of Marketing API v26.0, the Instagram Explore Feed placement was removed (explicitly specifying it in publisher_platforms/instagram_positions now returns an error) and the 'story' value in messenger_positions is silently dropped.

validate_only.description: Validate with Meta without creating or updating the ad set (default false)

name: create_adset
